n5fc701892f.headline: US to send around 1,000 troops from 82nd Airborne Division to Middle East
n5fc701892f.summary: About 1,000 troops from the 82nd Airborne Division will be sent to the Middle East. The move comes as the war's tempo remains high after Trump delayed his deadline for Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
n5fc701892f.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil trade, so military developments there matter directly for energy markets.

nfed389390c.headline: Mozambique: Debt Reaches 17.1 Billion Dollars
nfed389390c.summary: Mozambique's public debt rose by 2.16 percent in 2025, reaching 17.1 billion US dollars.
nfed389390c.why: Public debt levels shape a country's borrowing costs, sovereign credit risk and capacity to service obligations to creditors.

ne44ef7bad4.headline: Mozambique: 10 Million Dollars Allocated for Construction of Logistics Centres
ne44ef7bad4.summary: Mozambican authorities have allocated about 10 million US dollars for logistics centres in the northern provinces of Nampula and Cabo Delgado.
ne44ef7bad4.why: Logistics centres improve freight and trade flows, which affect costs for businesses moving goods through a region.

n03fadfc518.headline: UK drivers warned petrol and diesel prices rise by 25p as fuel crisis worsens
n03fadfc518.summary: Motorists are now paying 12p more per litre for petrol and 25p more for diesel as the fuel crisis worsens, according to the report.
n03fadfc518.why: Fuel prices feed directly into UK inflation and household spending, and they are set by global oil markets and refining margins.

ne1cf552582.headline: Carryover wheat stocks in Ukraine may reach 5 mln tonnes due to EU export restrictions – analysts
ne1cf552582.summary: Ukraine's carryover wheat stocks may reach 5 million tonnes due to restricted EU market access, with exports redirected toward the MENA region, analysts said.
ne1cf552582.why: Ukraine is a major global wheat exporter, so changes in its export routes affect world grain prices and food supply chains. EU trade restrictions shape where Ukrainian grain is sold.

nc0c8d94031.headline: EAC unions threaten further strike action
nc0c8d94031.summary: Workers at the Electricity Authority of Cyprus threatened escalating strikes. They demand independent investigation of suspicious activities they say undermine the state-run utility and raise consumer prices.
nc0c8d94031.why: The Electricity Authority of Cyprus is the state-run power utility, so labour disputes affect electricity supply and pricing on the island.

n50a33a973d.headline: Zelensky says Ukraine wants to import gas from Mozambique
n50a33a973d.summary: Ukraine is interested in importing liquefied natural gas from Mozambique, President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Monday. Kyiv is struggling to meet energy needs after Russian attacks on production infrastructure.
n50a33a973d.why: Liquefied natural gas is traded globally and is used by importers that lack pipeline supply. Supply deals shape European and emerging-market gas flows.

n4180e4006d.headline: airBaltic launches AirMall on Starlink-enabled flights
n4180e4006d.summary: Latvian airline airBaltic has become the first Starlink-connected airline to introduce AirMall by InterLnkd, which transforms its Wi-Fi portal.
n4180e4006d.why: airBaltic is the national carrier of Latvia, and in-flight connectivity and onboard retail are growing revenue opportunities for airlines.

nb5ba743e0f.headline: Central Bank warns of slower growth and rising inflation amid Middle East conflict
nb5ba743e0f.summary: The Central Bank of Cyprus warned that the Middle East war and the sharp rise in oil prices will hurt the Cypriot economy, mainly in the short term, and that inflation is set to rise.
nb5ba743e0f.why: Central bank forecasts shape expectations for interest rates, growth and inflation, which matter for investors in small open economies like Cyprus.

n278def0b3a.headline: Pine Gas & Jag Vasant: Two Indian LPG carriers scheduled to arrive this week after transiting Hormuz
n278def0b3a.summary: Indian LPG carriers Jag Vasant and Pine Gas have passed through the Strait of Hormuz and are scheduled to arrive at Indian ports between March 26 and 28.
n278def0b3a.why: India imports large volumes of LPG, and safe passage through Hormuz is important for domestic cooking gas supply.

n88db106380.headline: Hungary FM Admits Russia Contacts As EU Leak Claims Spark ‘Treason’ Row (Worthy News Investigation)
n88db106380.summary: The announced volume of prospective commercial real estate supply in Kyiv for 2026-2027 exceeds 243,000 square meters, according to UTG.
n88db106380.why: Commercial property supply shapes office and retail rents and developer activity. It is a gauge of investor confidence in the Ukrainian capital's property market.

nba71378338.headline: Bulls take charge at PSX as KSE-100 gains over 1,200 points
nba71378338.summary: The KSE-100 gained over 1,200 points at the Pakistan Stock Exchange as easing geopolitical tensions and lower global oil prices encouraged buyers. Bullish sentiment drew investors into the market.
nba71378338.why: The KSE-100 is the benchmark index of Pakistan Stock Exchange's largest listed companies. Oil prices affect Pakistan's import bill and inflation, so energy moves matter to its market.
nba71378338.why_moved: Easing geopolitical tensions and a decline in global oil prices encouraged bullish sentiment and drew buyers into the Pakistan Stock Exchange.

n53f79253e5.headline: Oil prices rise as Iran denies US talks, supply fears grow
n53f79253e5.summary: Brent crude rose $1.25 to $101.19 a barrel and WTI gained $2.15 to $90.28 a barrel by 08:58 GMT on 24 March. Iran denied US talks amid growing supply fears.
n53f79253e5.why: Brent and WTI are the main global benchmark crude oil prices, affecting fuel costs, inflation and energy company earnings.
n53f79253e5.why_moved: Iran's denial of US talks and growing supply fears pushed crude prices higher during the session.

nc8063882d8.headline: Iran war rages with Pentagon expected to send 82nd Airborne troops to Middle East
nc8063882d8.summary: The Pentagon is expected to send 82nd Airborne troops to the Middle East as the Iran war continues. Trump said several administration members were involved in talks with Iran.
nc8063882d8.why: US military deployments in the Middle East signal escalation risk, which affects oil prices, defence stocks and regional shipping. Investors track these moves for broader geopolitical risk.

nd708e53cf1.headline: Asia boosts coal use as Iran war squeezes global LNG supplies
nd708e53cf1.summary: Asian countries are increasing coal use as the Iran war squeezes global liquefied natural gas supplies. Analysts say coal may stabilise supplies for now but warn of worsening air pollution.
nd708e53cf1.why: LNG is a major source of power generation in Asia, and shortfalls push buyers toward coal. Shifts in fuel mix affect energy prices, utilities and coal producers.

nbcc7151075.headline: Israel News as Renewed Fighting Deflates De-Escalation Hopes
nbcc7151075.summary: Missile attacks caused casualties in Tel Aviv, and Israeli strikes hit southern Lebanon. The renewed fighting has prompted diplomatic and security responses across several capitals.
nbcc7151075.why: Escalation in the Israel region can drive risk sentiment, energy prices and regional capital flows.

n7545f33096.headline: India Must Be Prepared for Long-Term Impact of Middle East War, PM Modi Tells Rajya Sabha
n7545f33096.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi told the Rajya Sabha on Tuesday that India must be ready for any eventuality arising from the escalating Middle East war.
n7545f33096.why: India imports most of its crude oil, so prolonged Middle East conflict affects its fuel costs, inflation and current account.

nf1155e8f21.headline: Thai court holds gold mine operator liable for toxic runoff in a decade-old environmental case
nf1155e8f21.summary: A Thai court ruled that the operator of a major gold mine in northern Thailand is responsible for environmental damage and health impacts on nearby villagers. The verdict could set a precedent for climate litigation in the country.
nf1155e8f21.why: Mining companies face environmental liability and compensation costs, and court rulings can shape future regulation and litigation risk in the sector.

ne130bc0ab8.headline: International frameworks, legality of the US, Israel strikes on Iran and implications for the Global South, by Rommy Mom |
ne130bc0ab8.summary: Analyst Dan McTeague said recent commentary from US President Donald Trump is raising hopes of a de-escalation of the conflict in Iran, and Ontario gas prices are set to fall.
ne130bc0ab8.why: Ontario fuel prices track crude oil benchmarks, so geopolitical developments in the Middle East pass through quickly to pump prices.

n04149a2f49.headline: Study: Israel’s cost-of-living gaps deeper than income data shows | The Jerusalem Post
n04149a2f49.summary: A study finds Israel's cost-of-living gaps are deeper than income data shows. The Bank of Israel said in February that geopolitical uncertainty had resurfaced amid prospects of a confrontation with Iran.
n04149a2f49.why: Cost-of-living gaps affect household spending, inflation pressures and the economic outlook that the central bank monitors.

n1d871abcfe.headline: Amazon says AWS's Bahrain region 'disrupted' following drone activity
n1d871abcfe.summary: Amazon said its AWS Bahrain region is disrupted due to drone activity in the area. It is helping customers migrate to alternate AWS regions while the region recovers.
n1d871abcfe.why: Amazon Web Services is the largest cloud computing provider, so regional outages can affect the operations of many businesses that rely on its infrastructure.

n14ad99f924.headline: Japan to tap joint oil stockpiles, PM says, with no end seen to supply crisis
n14ad99f924.summary: Japan will tap joint oil stockpiles held by producing nations by end-March, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said. Global oil prices spiked to their highest since 2022.
n14ad99f924.why: Japan imports nearly all of its crude oil, so supply shocks quickly affect its economy and energy policy. Strategic stockpile releases are a standard tool to cushion supply losses.
n14ad99f924.why_moved: Supply losses from the Middle East conflict pushed global oil prices to their highest since 2022, prompting emergency measures in Japan.

n2e0640998f.headline: Fuel cost spikes are tanking hopes for Canadian business, survey suggests - National | Globalnews.ca
n2e0640998f.summary: A survey suggests rising fuel costs from the Iran war are starting to hit small and medium-sized businesses in Canada. The findings point to weaker sentiment among firms.
n2e0640998f.why: Small and mid-sized businesses are a large share of Canadian employment, and their confidence and costs are a useful read on the domestic economy.

nb6a6dfb106.headline: Rachel Reeves warns of ‘significant’ economic challenges from Iran war
nb6a6dfb106.summary: UK Chancellor Rachel Reeves updated MPs on the economic impact of the Middle East crisis, which has pushed up oil and gas prices.
nb6a6dfb106.why: The UK Chancellor sets fiscal policy and the government's economic outlook. Higher energy prices affect UK inflation, growth and gilt yields.

nd357e7202d.headline: Arm unveils new AI chip, expects it to add billions in annual revenue
nd357e7202d.summary: Arm Holdings announced a new artificial intelligence data center chip on Tuesday. The company said the product will add billions of dollars of revenue and mark a significant shift in strategy.
nd357e7202d.why: Arm designs the chip architecture licensed by most smartphone makers and is expanding into data center processors that compete with established chip suppliers.

impacts.name: Arm Holdings
impacts.why: The company expects the new AI chip to add billions of dollars in annual revenue.

n01d6f639e8.headline: Nigeria to spend $6.1 million on consultants for national fibre project
n01d6f639e8.summary: Nigeria plans to allocate $6.1 million to seven consulting firms and five individual consultants to support the rollout of its national fibre expansion project.
n01d6f639e8.why: Investment in national fibre infrastructure is key to improving digital connectivity and economic development in Nigeria.
